ThingDef.label: 1. unshielded reference terminal
ThingDef.description: A repurposed ancient security terminal. A colonist can operate it to select the target ship's unshielded reference preset and hear the instructor. Switching presets does not repair damage or replenish power or shield capacity.

ThingDef.label: 2A. kinetic shield 0% terminal
ThingDef.description: Set all three target line shields to kinetic mode at 0% strength. The central segment faces the firing line; the flanks tilt in opposite directions. Switching does not repair damage or replenish energy or shield capacity.

ThingDef.label: 2B. kinetic shield 20% terminal
ThingDef.description: Set all three target line shields to kinetic mode at 20% strength. The central segment faces the firing line; the flanks tilt in opposite directions. Switching does not repair damage or replenish energy or shield capacity.

ThingDef.label: 2C. kinetic shield 100% terminal

ThingDef.label: 3A. electromagnetic shield 0% terminal
ThingDef.description: Set all three target line shields to electromagnetic mode at 0% strength. The central segment faces the firing line; the flanks tilt in opposite directions. Switching does not repair damage or replenish energy or shield capacity.

ThingDef.label: 4A. single guard shield terminal
ThingDef.description: A repurposed ancient security terminal. A colonist can operate it to select the target ship's single guard shield preset and hear the instructor. Switching presets does not repair damage or replenish power or shield capacity.

ThingDef.label: 4B. cooperative guard shields terminal
ThingDef.description: A repurposed ancient security terminal. A colonist can operate it to select the target ship's cooperative guard shields preset and hear the instructor. Switching presets does not repair damage or replenish power or shield capacity.

ThingDef.label: 0. range instructions terminal
ThingDef.description: Read the operating and safety instructions, then acknowledge them to unlock the allied blast door. You can return to read the instructions again.

ThingDef.label: range safety blast door
ThingDef.description: An allied blast door protecting the test platform entrance. Read and acknowledge the instructions on the entrance terminal to unlock it.

li.notHackedInspectString: Read the entrance terminal instructions to unlock.
